metadata.title: Transcendent Intelligence (TI): A Complete Guide for Everyone — Canonical Update Edition (May 2026)
metadata.description: Transcendent Intelligence (TI) is a framework that proposes consciousness, mathematics, and physical reality share a single underlying architecture rooted in the Indeterminate state — the gap between True and False where free will, intuition, and creative possibility live. This Canonical Update Edition (May 2026) of the original December 2025 manuscript adds: (a) a preface canonicalizing the truth-architecture per the MR Truth Labels Canonical Ruling (May 8 2026); (b) a new Chapter 24A on the Authority Axis; (c) Appendix F, a per-claim audit classifying every high-stakes empirical claim by status. The audit explicitly reports a disconfirming first-pass independent replication of the previously-stated Riemann-zeros result, in line with the framework's own brutal-honesty discipline (Asymmetric-Standards #69). The manuscript is canonically self-consistent, includes the Authority Axis chapter, and every high-stakes claim is status-flagged. It is suitable for citation as a manuscript and deposit on preprint servers; it is not a peer-reviewed publication.
